title: PCR Setup Using a CSV File
author: Opentrons
materials: Load reagents and labware into required slots.

steps.title: Configure deck and upload CSV
steps.instruction: Set up the robot deck: reserve slots 2, 5, 8, and 11 for input tube racks; reserve slot 6 for a 384‑well PCR plate and slot 9 for a 96‑well PCR plate; use the remaining slots for tips. Apply the Jan 13 2021 fix that enables use of slots 5, 8, and 11. Prepare a custom PCR‑setup CSV (or download the template CSV) and upload it to the robot.

substeps.instruction: Reserve slots 2, 5, 8, and 11 for input tube racks.
Reserve slot 6 for a 384‑well PCR plate.
Reserve slot 9 for a 96‑well PCR plate.
Use all other slots for tip racks.
Apply the Jan 13 2021 software fix that allows slots 5, 8, and 11 to be used.
Customize the PCR‑setup CSV (or use the provided template) and upload it.

steps.title: Load labware and reagents
steps.instruction: Place the required labware in the designated slots: Opentrons P20‑single‑channel electronic pipettes (GEN2), Opentrons 20 µL filter tips, Opentrons 4‑in‑1 tube rack set, and the appropriate 384‑well or 96‑well PCR plate.

substeps.instruction: Load the Opentrons P20‑single‑channel electronic pipette (GEN2).
Load Opentrons 20 µL filter tip racks into tip slots.
Load the Opentrons 4‑in‑1 tube rack set into one of the input tube rack slots.
Load the 384‑well PCR plate into slot 6 or the 96‑well PCR plate into slot 9, as required.

steps.title: Execute the protocol
steps.instruction: Start the protocol on the robot to perform the PCR setup as defined in the uploaded CSV file.
